items.title: Jalen Duren re-signs with Pistons, Stephen Curry and Jamal Shead extensions, and another Hield trade
items.body_excerpt: Jalen Duren is re-signing with the Pistons for five years, $200 million. Sam and I review the deal and then look ahead into potential trades when he becomes trade-eligible in January. We also discuss other extensions for Stephen Curry and Jamal Shead and how they impact their…
